Academy
of archetypal
consulting Articles Get details HOW TO WORK WITH HOMEOPATHY? Drinking homeopathy is just one of the options. The task: to synchronize with the vibration of the drug. The founder of homeopathy, Hahnemann, himself wrote that drugs do not necessarily have to be drunk - they can be sniffed. The drugs can be held in the hand, carried with you. Since each drug is a frequency, bioresonance devices have now been created that emit the vibrations of drugs. Even audio files have been recorded that carry the vibrations of drugs. At a certain level, it works even if you just write the name of the drug on your hand or say it over water. __ This is so that you understand that I did not come up with something myself, but these are the principles of work that modern homeopathy shares and supports! Statistics I watched a video on the Internet where they say homeopathy is difficult to verify statistically. Of course it doesn't work that way! It's like gathering 100 people and asking them to try on shoes of the same size. The selection of homeopathy should be based not on physical symptoms, but on the parameters of the psyche! The level of stability, current stress, source of stress, etc. This is difficult work. It is so subtle and individual that I really cannot imagine how it is possible to select a drug only based on its descriptions. Even for the same person, different drugs are relevant at different times. The essence of healing in homeopathy is to catch resonance. That is, to find the deep pain of a person and select a drug based on resonance that will support in this situation and redirect the mental process. Homeopathy of subpersonalities is even more difficult, we find and cure hidden stresses of split parts of the soul. ___ PS. This is very valuable. A person may have mental pain that aches all the time. Neither wine, nor drugs, nor a psychotherapist will heal it. But homeopathy can penetrate to the depths of pain and bring it out from there. Duration I am asked, is the correction permanent? Yes. The energy of the preparation is integrated into the body. It changes the parameters, qualities of your personality. But I think that in order for the effect to be more clearly fixed, it is better to do 4 sessions for one request, reinforcing the situation from different sides. - How long does it take? - In general, 2 months. Preparations/qualities from each session are integrated in about 2 weeks. Within 4 sessions, we gradually strengthen the situation from different sides, adding new facets, qualities, enhancing the effect. For one stage, one request, 4 sessions are usually enough for consolidation. HOMEOPATHY AND MONEY It should be said that almost the majority of all requests to me are about money. Variations: - fear of communicating with people - uncertainty - difficulty communicating with clients, clients give little money, etc. It would seem, what does homeopathy have to do with it? But as it turns out, it is through this method that one can find the key solution to problems. Let me explain. #1. Through the arrangement at the beginning of the session, I can easily tell everyone where the difficulties are, where the opportunities are, what the clients want, etc. I show the plan of what needs to be done. But. This needs to be done! And then internal stupors and fears arise. The person resists change. #2. And then we launch the process of cultivating personal qualities (support, stability, confidence, energy, activity, etc.). We restore the potential of the personality, restore subpersonalities and return to ourselves the potential that was laid down in us from birth and even before birth. Each session has an effect and transformation! Homeopathic preparations + sephirotic mandalas + crystals and places of power allow you to change the qualities of personality and, thus, rewrite the script of life!:) QUANTUM PRINCIPLES OF HOMEOPATHY Doses, dilution levels of preparations in homeopathy are so high that they work beyond Avogadro's number. That is, there are no more physical molecules of the substance in the preparation. Only its information trace remains. And the laws of the preparation's operation at this level do not correspond to physical laws, but to the laws of quantum physics. THERE ARE A NUMBER OF PRINCIPLES IN QUANTUM PHYSICS: #1. The principle of resonance: - if the frequency of exposure coincides with the frequency of the system, this causes significant vibrations; - in homeopathy, the frequency of the substance is selected so that it coincides with the frequency of the malfunction in the body. #2. The principle of non-locality - related particles instantly influence each other, regardless of the distance; - in homeopathy, the approach of remote influence on a person using his photo is used. #3. The memory of water - water remembers information about a substance, even if it is not in it. - in homeopathy, diluting a substance in water many times, the preparation preserves information about this substance. #4. Quantum effect (of ultra-small quantities) - even a single photon, quantum through portions of quantization can significantly affect the system - in homeopathy, the effect is carried out by ultra-small doses of the substance through the information field. #5. The observer influences the state of the system - observation records the required probability - in homeopathy, the awareness, intention of the client and the doctor significantly affects the result. #6. Transition point: - in transition states, even a small impact affects the result; - in homeopathy, critical human states, stresses, crises allow one to influence through wave action. #7. The principle of stability (minimal action) - quantum systems strive for stability, avoiding possible changes - in homeopathy, ultra-low doses of drugs have a minimal effect on other systems, minimizing side effects, while stimulating the body to self-regulate to preserve its resources. DRUG COMBINATIONS - How many drugs are prescribed at a time in archetypal homeopathy? - I usually prescribe 2-3 drugs. In classical homeopathy, one drug is prescribed at a time. And I understand them. A combination of drugs can either improve the resonance and effect of drugs, or it can reduce the resonance. That is why in my work I have to spend time double-checking combinations of different drugs. Often these should be drugs of the same potency, one sector, etc. But in general, a combination of 3 drugs works three times stronger than one drug. Well, it is easier for classical homeopaths to track the effect if they work with one drug. It is easier for me, I can immediately say quite clearly what the effect will be from each drug and from their combination. Which is what we observe with each client, as a result, after 2 weeks. 😉 2. And of course, working through crystals increases the strength of the preparations several times. Since I have a lot of requests for work, and few crystals, I usually add crystals in an expanded format of working with a request. __ In archetypal homeopathy, the most important thing is to choose the right preparation and dose: a fulcrum to make a transformation.) And this is not so simple. RESONANCE IN HOMEOPATHY I continue to explore the work of the method. You know what's interesting, in addition to the resonance between the drug and the person, there needs to be a resonance between the drugs. Otherwise it will feel like a radio with different programs turned on in parallel. And it will interfere with the process. This is not so common, but I have seen cases when - first you need to experience the energies of Arnica (fear, shock) and only then you can move on to other drugs, for example Pulsatilla (love, care), - also sometimes drugs require that their dilution level be close. Today I worked with a client. The drugs worked perfectly separately, but not together. I will tell you the art of selecting such a set of drugs so that it carries resonance and strengthens a person. This is what we do ;) force of impact I will tell you how the force of influence changes through different methods in our correction I WILL TAKE A CASE OF WORKING WITH A CLIENT (towards the goal) BASIC DIAGNOSTICS - Interest, readiness: +2 units - Stupor, confusion -5 units #1. IMPACT OF HOMEOPATHY BY PHOTO - interest +3 units - confusion -3 units * The indicators improved by 1.5 times, but I want more, which means the reason is hidden deeper, in early stresses, subpersonalities. #2. WE WORK THROUGH HOMEOPATHY SUBPERSONALITIES, I create a mandala of a subpersonality, I influence it. - Interest: 4.5 units - Confusion: 1.5 units * Conclusion: working through subpersonalities reduced internal resistance by 3 times and increased motivation by 2 times. Subpersonality homeopathy is 1.5 times more effective than basic homeopathy. It works well on internal stupors. #3. SUPPORT THROUGH CRYSTALS. I add crystals: - Interest 6.5 units - Confusion 1.5 units. * Conclusion: crystals increase the supporting motivation signal by another 1.5 times. #4. I REMOVE HOMEOPATHY AND CRYSTALS: - Interest 3 units - Confusion 2.5 units. * Conclusion: the basic effect is preserved. But to consolidate the effect, the preparations should stand for another two weeks. #5. PLACE OF POWER I put the client's photo on the Place of Power - Interest 4.5 (+1.5) - Embarrassment 2.5 * Conclusion: The Place of Power increases the supporting motivation by 1.5 times. #6. PLACE OF POWER + SUBPERSONALITY Place of Power + Subpersonality Mandala - Interest 5.5 (+1) - Embarrassment 2 units (-0.5) * Conclusion: working through the subpersonality on the Place of Power is more effective than simply influencing the photo of the personality. #7. PLACE OF POWER + HOMEOPATHY Subpersonality + Place of Power + homeopathy - Interest 6.5 (+1) - Embarrassment 1.5 (-0.5) * Conclusion. Working through the Place of Power increases the effect of homeopathy in terms of support and motivation by 1.5 times (6.5 instead of 4.5). #8. PLACE OF POWER + CRYSTALS (Subpersonality + homeopathy + crystals at the Place of Power). Interest 7.5 units (+1) Confusion 1.5 units * Conclusion: enhancing the impact through crystals and the Place of Power has a similar effect. When superimposed, they enhance each other. TOTAL : - a combination of different factors allows you to increase the effect of the impact many times over. - it is possible to increase motivation almost 4 times and reduce stupor towards the goal by 3 times magic or homeopathy I ask myself what is stronger, magic or homeopathy. And you know, it is difficult to answer. The primary magical effect can be many times stronger than homeopathy. But homeopathy is so gently integrated into the personality structure that it transforms it from the inside. For example, if you take a drug like Pulstailla - these are essentially the vibrations of a buttercup flower. Weak and gentle. The softest, subtlest energy. But for support in situations of sadness, loneliness, the most transformative effect for the soul can arise precisely through support in the energies of buttercup, and not through all other energies and pills. It is amazing, but it works. Homeopathy works not through the energies of force, but through resonance. The main thing is to choose the resonance. Psychotherapy, Homeopathy and Sephirotic Magic Psychotherapy, homeopathy and sephirotic magic are very close. #1. When I, as a psychotherapist, work with clients in therapy, we manifest and compensate for the basic deficiencies of subpersonalities through imagery work. #2. In homeopathy, we do essentially the same thing, but through the subconscious. The drugs work with your parts of the soul 24 hours a day, strengthening and transforming the body of the psyche. #3. Sephirotic mandalas work almost like homeopathy. But we influence parts of the soul not with drugs, but with tarot arcana or archetypal tools of ancient traditions. __ The deeper the impact, the more complex problems you can work with. pages.text:
MORE ABOUTE LONDON FESTIVAL OF HOLISTIC TEMPLE ARTS 9-15 July (Sunday to Saturday) 9 of July. FREE KUNDALINI REIKI class & attunement. This is one of the most important initiation you can get. At the Sunday Class you will be able to get Kundalini Reiki attunement Level 1. Kundalini Reiki - is the system that opens up energy channels. It works soft but strong. Kundalini Reiki is a few times more powerful than a classical Usui Reiki system because it is combination of Usui Reiki and Kundalini Flow. Kundalini Reiki attunement is enlighting your mind, provides you with extra energy support and increase your sensuality, extrasensual abilities. Kundalini Reiki level 1 attunement usually costs 200 eur. You can get Kundalini Reiki attunement free as a gift (donation) at our Sunday 9 of July class. - Why am I sharing this Free? - Because I want you to start feeling the energy flows, to open up your potential and get prepared to the more advanced business and shamanic technologies we can practice later at other classes. I highly recommend this class to start. 9 July, Sunday, 5 pm
Shamanic Theater. 
Love & Money.
Business Constellations. Second class of Sunday is also outstanding. We will be focusing on the money & business topic. System constellations - is the special instrument that looks like a theater. It allows you to get deeper into the key reason of your question: money, love etc. 1. At first you can see how it works. Someone could present his/ her case and we will find an answer (solution). You can come out with any question about business and money growth. 2. At the second part I will let everyone to experience system constellation in the shamanic flow format. You wll be able to research you relationships with money (or love). Are you connected to it? What stops you to get it more? Are you satisfied with that? What are your potentials? What are your money talking to you. That would be a simultaneous shamanic play, where you can see what is happening in your life with money like in a mirrow. Everybody will get the personal insight from the class! A few more words about Business Constellations (9 of July class). That's the amazing technology that allows you to make a marketing plan for your business project within 30 minutes. You can get information about the strengths and weaknesses of your business, its opportunities and threats. The information is pretty accurate. The technology is based on the family constellations approach from Bert Hellinger but combined with system modelling, NLP and oriented on business. My clients after the session usually get a quick understanding of what to do next and multiply their business. I love sharing business constellation sessions with my clients in person. Btw. Besides the class of 9 of July, you can request and get the personal Express Business Constellations diagnostics for yourself or your business project. 0 Read More Monday. 10.07. 7 pm.
Imagery Hypnotherapy class. Why it is important? Results outside are based on the inner stability and power within. Imagery hypnotherapy program - is the soft deep approach that allows you - to train your therapy skills - to grow your power, build up your stable psychological fundament. Personal stability is the bases for success in your life. That is the fundament for other techniques. WHAT WILL BE THERE: 1. You can come 15 minutes before the class, chat, relax drink tea. You can bring fruits to tea if you like. 2. In the class you will study how imagery hypnotherapy works (Jung-based). 3. You will see a short example of the session. 4. You will be able to train practical skills of leading hypnotherapy sessions. 5. You will be able to get your own personal therapy session to relax and empower. This is a chill class. You can bring a notebook and colourful pens to draw your images. Why do I like the Imagery hypnotherapy approach? It's one of the softest and deepest technologies that transforms people from within. I was studying and practicing several therapy approaches: - classical hypnotherapy - positive psychotherapy (Peseschkian) - body psychotherapy etc. However, when the reason of the situation is hidden deeply in childhood or unconscious, the best approach to deal with it is Imagery hypnotherapy. The beauty of this method is 1. It's very refreshing and recovering. At the session, you can deeply relax and restore energy. 2. Through the images of unconsciousness you can softly reveal the reason of your problem, the past traumas that were excluded, but it still drains your energy away. 3. It's very delicate. We can go as deep as you are ready only. I am admired how people are softly changing  through this method, getting more grounded, relaxed and happy in their life. About half of the personal sessions, I am holding I do through the imagery hypnotherapy approach. Read More REGISTRATION You can pay as much as you like! Limitted number of spots available. For registration send a messege to Olha organizer - telegram: T.me/QUniverse - whatsapp: +44785836877 And fill: - Google form BOOK NOW Wednesday. 12.07.
Introduction to Shamanism.
Shamanic Constellations. Shamanic & Temple technologies - are the key instruments to activate the powers of your unconscious, your Intuition and Intention. As much as you are connected to higher archetypes the more support you get to realize your dream (money, love etc). AATA Academy is sharing an outstanding, comprehensive program for studying shamanic technologies. The first step is class Shamanic Constellations 12.07. It is the class with special combination of system constellations approach and shamanism. Our tasks for the class are to 1) start feeling the Shamanic Flow. 2) to study how to be guided by it and get information from there. 3) how to get to know and awake the sacral animal of your power. Welcome to the class. Thursday. 13.07, 7 pm.
Practical Shamanism.
Money Magic & Runic Reiki. Around half of my consultations are focused on money & business issues. There 3 options to work with that: #1. Business constellations (when you need to do quick analyses and find new ideas). #2. System constellations + hypnotherapy (when the strains & limitations are within). #3. Shamanic constellation (when you need to activate the process through the Powers of the big archetypes). On Thursday our tasks are - to get connected to the Powers or Runes (Runes Reiki) - and to train the skill of influencing your situations and, money questions through the Runes Reiki. Runes Reiki is one of the most powerful instrument to realize your goals. You can get the Free Level 1 attunement. You are welcome to join. PS. That is an advanced class. To understand the class better is recommended visiting one of our classes before. COSTS You can pay as much as you like! Limitted number of spots available. BOOK NOW Friday. 14.07, 7 pm.
Practical Shamanism.
Tarot Mysteries Class. That is the first class of the advanced program of studying Practical Tarot Technologies. The topic for the class is the Star (17th Tarot Arcana). We will be tuning into the bright energy of the Planet for healing and rejuvenation. Our task for the program is to get the skills of 1) Tarot readings, 2) Tarot as the practical instrument for healing, 3) Tarot as the practical instrument for influencing the situation (money, love etc). We will be studying both energywork with Tarot Cards and Tarot Mysteries, Shamanic Constellations. Someone can get a personal Tarot Attunement and Tarot shamanic constellation. Tarot is the mental computer of advanced civilizations. Its one of the most advanced technology for personal growth. Register Saturday 15.07
12.00 Love Magic &
Tantric Constellations. Are you ready to be loved? Do you deserve love? What is your love? Is it care or abandonment? How to heal it. I am inviting you to the Love Temple. * The first part will be the Family Constellation You will be able to get in touch with your inner love. See it. Heal it. * The Second part will be the Tantric Reiki class. You can get the Reiki Love Flow attunement. You can be in touch with the unlimited flow of love to express it and share. * The third part would be the Temple constellation or Eros. We will tune into the energies of love and desire. You will get attunement into the magical instrument of Eros. * The third part would be the Tantric bodywork. You can receive love and share it. You can join any part of it or the whole day program. Feel free to take some snacks and fruits to eat during the breaks between the modules. Welcome to the class. LOCATION: We are planning location around East Acton area London. W3 7JP BOOK NOW REGISTRATION You can pay as much as you like! Limitted number of spots available. For registration send a messege to Olha organizer - telegram: T.me/QUniverse - whatsapp: +44785836877 And fill: - Google form BOOK NOW FESTIVAL PLAN: 1. SUNDAY, 9.07 * 15.00. Reiki Therapy Club (Special Gift - Kundalini Reiki). * 17.00. Shamanic Constellations. Temple of Love & Money. Costs: pay what you want. 2. MONDAY. 10 July. * 19.00. Dreams Temple. The source of your power. We study the principles of Imagerial Hypnotherapy. Costs: pay what you want. 3. WEDNESDAY. 12 July. * 19.00. Shamanic Constellations. Animal of your Power. pages.text: ARCHETYPAL THERAPY ACADEMY NEAREST EVENTS August 2023 London EVENTS SCHEDULE: 8.08 Tuesday - Family & Love healing class (family constellations). 9.08 Money & Business consulting (business constellations) 10.08 Body & Energy Therapy class (Runic Reiki Circle). 11.08 Friday -  Tarot Ritual (Shamanic Mysteries). DETAILS: - TIME: 7.00-9.45 pm. LOCATION: - London Center. Theatre Deli, 107 Leadenhall St, London EC3A 4AF COSTS: * FREE for the newcomers & volunteers. * 20£ recommended donation for any group class. * 50-100£ for the personal session within a class. Tantric Antique Mysteries School. Tantra is the Cosmic Dance of Masculine & Feminine. Tantric men and women - are the one that are able to combine the Universe of the Power and Beauty within. We study how to accept your power and face your weaknesses, to erose & balance your desires. The first level of our school is the self exploration and tantric therapy: - Tantric Family Constellations, - Body psychotherapy, - Imagerial hypnotherapy, - Archetypal Reiki energy therapy. At the second level of study we are discovering - Archetypal shamanic technologies - Ancient Greek & Egyptian Mysteries & attunements to embody the powers of transcedental Archetypes of Humanity for your clarity and realization. That is the brief study plan of the Archetypal Therapy Academy. HOW TO REGISTER FOR THE CLASS: To book your place please fill in the registration form: Google Form To get more details, news you can join our whatsapp group: WhatsApp THE LIST OF EVENTS: 8.08 - Family & Love healing class (family constellations). In the slow careful shamanic flow we let our family situations to he revealed and healed. We will be following the shamanic field. Everybody will get personal exploration. 9.08 - Money & Business consulting (business constellations) I invite you for exploration of your momey, business projects, its disxover its perspectives and limitations. You will find new ideas how to grow you projects. Usually personal session costs 150£. But during the class you will be able to get the personal session FREE. 10.08 - Body & Energy Therapy class (Runic Reiki Circle). We will be working with the healing tunings of the Runic Reiki. We will be doing some tantric bodywok for you to be able to relax, heal your body & soul, practice  energy Runic Reiki energy healing and focus Runic Reiki energy towards realizing your dreams. U can get the Runic Reiki Attunement for FREE (usual price 250£). 11.08 - Tarot Ritual (Shamanic Mysteries). We will be tuning into the Archetypes of Tarot Arcanas for you to empower yourself and your desires (love, health, money etc). You can visit all classes or the one that you prefer. For every event: - Time: 7.00-9.30 p.m. You are welcome! A few words of the therapies I like doing worldwide. 1. FREE Diagnostics/ Reading. We can go with any question: love, relationships, money, business, personal growth etc. Diagnostics is done through system constellations method by photo. I can help you to find the root of the situation, reason of the problem and possible solutions. It is totally free. To get the diagnistics all you need is to fill in the request form and send a photo. No online participation required. You will get the answer in text or audio format within a few days after the request. Usually even one free express diagnostics is enough to understand what is going on and to choose the right focus for your actions. 2. The second program I like doing is Tantric Family Constellations. (8 August). t is the shamanic exploration of the topics of Love & Sexuality. We are tuning into the Archetypes of love to explore and heal your innerself. I like people start shining from within, awoke their feelings, sensations and sexualitu. Tantric Family Constellation program usually includes topics: Session 1. 3 stages of Love & Eros in your life. Session 2. Balance of Love & Sex Constellation Session 3. Yin & Yang. Session 4. Love & Rejection Session 5. Freedom & Connection Session 6. The Hidden Desires. Sessions are held online individually and offline in groups. Costs: 100£/ session. In August: 50% discount. 3. The third program I am passionate about is the Business Constellations (9.08) Its amazingly to see when the clients are opening up the direction of their real predestination. They find out the true perspective directions in their life, business, career, self realization etc. They start moving towards it and achieve the outstanding results. At the beginning my clients are afraid of their true potential. But eventually they start moving towards it, increase their financial potential in a few times and open up the new streams in their life. I love this method. And are proud to share it. The first class in this direction we gonna held on 9.08. Usually personal support program consists of 8 sessions (online) or group sessions offline. More information: Read More Registration for personal session: Google Form 4. The forth program I love sharing - is the Therapy sessions and classes. Being the certified hypnotherapist, psychotherapist, psychologist I enjoy my clients to get their power back. Inner power and balance gives to my clients the sense of harmony and happiness, their relationships flourish and  realization growth. How do I work: - usually our sessions are based on imagerial psychotherapy (dreams alive), - sometimes I add body psychotherapy practices to heal and support inner kid. These sessions help to get your power back and realise your dreams. The body & energy healing class (Runic Reiki Massage), 11.08 will be the combination of - Body therapy session - Imagery therapy - Plus the energy therapy session through Runic Reiki or Tantra Reiki flow. I like this type of body & energy therapy classes, because they allow you to revitalize your body and soul and activate your goals. More information: Read More 5. Archetypal Therapy  (Shamanic Mysteries). This is the most profound and advanced program. Why do I like it? 1) It's highly practical. Tunings into the ancient archetypes activates your mental potential. Your desires, goals start realizing much faster comparing to other technologies. 2) It's beautiful. Ancient archetypes possess the ideals of power and beauty of the Humanity. 3) It is the Path of spiritual growth. By Synchronizing with the Temple and shamanic archetypes we activate our potential and harmonize our life and soul. Archetypal Therapy - is the main Study Program of our Academy. We deeply study archetypes it through Egypt, Greece attunements, Runes & Tarot. The Class on 11.08 will be dedicated to the Tarot Mysteries & Technologies to attract any goals to your life. Facilitator: Andy Li (Certified Psychotherapist, Hypnotherapist, psychologist, Instructor of System & Business Constellations, Master of Reiki, Magister of Egypt & Greece Sacral Temple Mysteries.) See you soon! COSTS Recommended donation: 20£. Free Participation for volunteers. pages.text:
MORE ABOUTE LONDON FESTIVAL OF HOLISTIC TEMPLE ARTS 9-15 July (Sunday to Saturday) 9 of July. FREE KUNDALINI REIKI class & attunement. This is one of the most important initiation you can get. At the Sunday Class you will be able to get Kundalini Reiki attunement Level 1. Kundalini Reiki - is the system that opens up energy channels. It works soft but strong. Kundalini Reiki is a few times more powerful than a classical Usui Reiki system because it is combination of Usui Reiki and Kundalini Flow. Kundalini Reiki attunement is enlighting your mind, provides you with extra energy support and increase your sensuality, extrasensual abilities. Kundalini Reiki level 1 attunement usually costs 200 eur. You can get Kundalini Reiki attunement free as a gift (donation) at our Sunday 9 of July class. - Why am I sharing this Free? - Because I want you to start feeling the energy flows, to open up your potential and get prepared to the more advanced business and shamanic technologies we can practice later at other classes. I highly recommend this class to start. 9 July, Sunday, 5 pm
Shamanic Theater. 
Love & Money.
Business Constellations. Second class of Sunday is also outstanding. We will be focusing on the money & business topic. System constellations - is the special instrument that looks like a theater. It allows you to get deeper into the key reason of your question: money, love etc. 1. At first you can see how it works. Someone could present his/ her case and we will find an answer (solution). You can come out with any question about business and money growth. 2. At the second part I will let everyone to experience system constellation in the shamanic flow format. You wll be able to research you relationships with money (or love). Are you connected to it? What stops you to get it more? Are you satisfied with that? What are your potentials? What are your money talking to you. That would be a simultaneous shamanic play, where you can see what is happening in your life with money like in a mirrow. Everybody will get the personal insight from the class! A few more words about Business Constellations (9 of July class). That's the amazing technology that allows you to make a marketing plan for your business project within 30 minutes. You can get information about the strengths and weaknesses of your business, its opportunities and threats. The information is pretty accurate.
